name: MaloneX
description: WhatsApp bot with session import from your pairing site, health monitoring and plain-language diagnostics

SESSION.description: Your session string from the pairing site. A password for the whole WhatsApp account: never share it.

OWNER_PHONE.description: Extra owner phone number, digits only with country code. The linked account is always the first owner.

ACCESS_KEY.description: Key for the built-in pairing page and the admin overview endpoint. Auto-generated per deployment; reset it any time.

MODE.description: public: strangers may use public commands. private: only owners.

PAIRING_SITE_URL.description: Your pairing site, shown as the button on the bot's start page.

SESSION_PREFIX.description: Force the expected prefix of the SESSION value, e.g. MaloneX for "MaloneX~eyJ...".

PAIR_NUMBER.description: Phone number to pair from the server console at boot when no session exists. The code is printed once to the log.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Trust X-Forwarded-For for rate limiting. Default true on Heroku, false elsewhere.

DATA_DIR.description: File storage directory. Only used when no Postgres is configured.
